passages.text: Then the man brought me back to the gate that faces east, and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.
passages.sermon:
A man led me to the gate.
This gate faced east.
I saw the glory of the God of Israel.
The glory of God came from the east.
God’s voice sounded like the roar of many waters.
His glory made the whole earth shine.
passages.original: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֖נִי אֶל־ הַשָּׁ֑עַר שַׁ֕עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֹּנֶ֖ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃ וְהִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וְקוֹל֗וֹ כְּקוֹל֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִכְּבֹדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when He came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the River Kebar. I fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a prophet of Israel.
Ezekiel saw a vision.
This vision looked like the vision he saw when God came to destroy the city.
This vision also looked like the visions Ezekiel saw by the River Kebar.
Ezekiel fell facedown.
The glory of the LORD entered the temple.
The glory of the LORD came through the gate that faces east.
passages.original: וּכְמַרְאֵ֨ה הַמַּרְאֶ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֗יתִי כַּמַּרְאֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֙יתִי֙ בְּבֹאִי֙ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר וּמַרְא֕וֹת כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֶל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־ פָּנָֽי׃ וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה בָּ֣א אֶל־ הַבָּ֑יִת דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃

passages.text: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
passages.sermon: The Spirit lifted me up.\r\nThe Spirit brought me into the inner court.\r\nThe glory of the LORD filled the temple.
passages.original: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וַתְּבִיאֵ֕נִי אֶל־ הֶֽחָצֵ֖ר הַפְּנִימִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple, and He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.
passages.sermon:
A man stood beside me.
I heard someone speak to me from inside the temple.
He spoke to me.
He said, “Son of man, listen.
This is the place of My throne.
This is the place for the soles of My feet.
I will live here among the Israelites forever.
The house of Israel will not defile My holy name again.
They will not defile it.
Their kings will not defile it.
They will not defile it by their prostitution.
They will not defile it by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.”
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֛ע מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י מֵהַבָּ֑יִת וְאִ֕ישׁ הָיָ֥ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֶצְלִֽי׃ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ אֶת־ מְק֣וֹם כִּסְאִ֗י וְאֶת־ מְקוֹם֙ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶשְׁכָּן־ שָׁ֛ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְלֹ֣א יְטַמְּא֣וּ ע֣וֹד בֵּֽית־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֞י הֵ֤מָּה וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בִּזְנוּתָ֔ם וּבְפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם בָּמוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts, with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed. Therefore I have consumed them in My anger.
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the people of Israel.
They put their threshold next to God's threshold.
They put their doorposts beside God's doorposts.
Only a wall stood between God and them.
They committed abominations.
They defiled God's holy name by these abominations.
God became angry.
God consumed them in His anger.
passages.original: בְּתִתָּ֨ם סִפָּ֜ם אֶת־ סִפִּ֗י וּמְזֽוּזָתָם֙ אֵ֣צֶל מְזוּזָתִ֔י וְהַקִּ֖יר בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְטִמְּא֣וּ׀ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֗י בְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ וָאֲכַ֥ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּאַפִּֽי׃

passages.text: Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will dwell among them forever.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God addressed the people of Israel.
God commanded the Israelites to remove their prostitution from Him.
God commanded the Israelites to remove the funeral offerings for their kings from Him.
If the Israelites remove these sins, God will dwell among them forever.
passages.original: עַתָּ֞ה יְרַחֲק֧וּ אֶת־ זְנוּתָ֛ם וּפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities. Let them measure the plan, and if they are ashamed of all they have done, then make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement and its exits and entrances—its whole design along with all its statutes, forms, and laws. Write it down in their sight, so that they may keep its complete design and all its statutes and may carry them out.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel, the son of man.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the people of Israel.
God told Ezekiel to describe the temple to them.
God wanted the people of Israel to hear about the temple.
God wanted the people to feel ashamed of their sins.
God told Ezekiel to let the people measure the plan of the temple.
If the people felt ashamed of all they had done, Ezekiel should show them the design of the temple.
Ezekiel should show them the arrangement of the temple.
Ezekiel should show them the exits and entrances of the temple.
Ezekiel should show them the whole design of the temple.
Ezekiel should show them all the statutes of the temple.
Ezekiel should show them all the forms of the temple.
Ezekiel should show them all the laws of the temple.
Ezekiel should write all these things down in front of the people.
The people must keep the complete design of the temple.
The people must keep all the statutes of the temple.
The people must do all these things.
passages.original: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת וְיִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵעֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וּמָדְד֖וּ אֶת־ תָּכְנִֽית׃ וְאִֽם־ נִכְלְמ֞וּ מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֗וּ צוּרַ֣ת הַבַּ֡יִת וּתְכוּנָת֡וֹ וּמוֹצָאָ֡יו וּמוֹבָאָ֣יו וְֽכָל־ צֽוּרֹתָ֡ו וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָיו֩ וְכָל־ צוּרֹתָי וְכָל־ תּוֹרֹתוֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אוֹתָ֔ם וּכְתֹ֖ב לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ צוּרָת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָ֖יו וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: This is the law of the temple: All its surrounding territory on top of the mountain will be most holy. Yes, this is the law of the temple.
passages.sermon:
The law of the temple is this.
The temple stands on top of the mountain.
All the land around the temple is most holy.
This is the law of the temple.
passages.original: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠הָר כָּל־ גְּבֻל֞וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה־ זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): Its gutter shall be a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around its edge. And this is the height of the altar: The space from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide. The space from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide.
passages.sermon:
The altar is a holy structure in the temple.
These are the measurements of the altar.
Use long cubits for these measurements.
A long cubit is a cubit and a handbreadth.
The gutter of the altar is one cubit deep.
The gutter is also one cubit wide.
A rim surrounds the edge of the gutter.
The rim is one span wide.
This is the height of the altar.
From the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge is two cubits.
The lower ledge is one cubit wide.
From the lower ledge to the upper ledge is four cubits.
The upper ledge is one cubit wide.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ בָּֽאַמּ֔וֹת אַמָּ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה וָטֹ֑פַח וְחֵ֨יק הָאַמָּ֜ה וְאַמָּה־ רֹ֗חַב וּגְבוּלָ֨הּ אֶל־ שְׂפָתָ֤הּ סָבִיב֙ זֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ד וְזֶ֖ה גַּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ וּמֵחֵ֨יק הָאָ֜רֶץ עַד־ הָעֲזָרָ֤ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה֙ שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּמֵהֳעֲזָרָ֨ה הַקְּטַנָּ֜ה עַד־ הָעֲזָרָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב הָאַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth.
passages.sermon: The altar hearth is four cubits high.\r\nFour horns rise up from the altar hearth.
passages.original: וְהַֽהַרְאֵ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֑וֹת וּמֵהָאֲרִאֵ֣יל וּלְמַ֔עְלָה הַקְּרָנ֖וֹת אַרְבַּֽע׃

passages.text: The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
The altar hearth is the top part of the altar.
The altar hearth is square in shape.
The altar hearth has four corners.
The altar hearth measures twelve cubits in length.
The altar hearth measures twelve cubits in width.
passages.original: וְהָאֲרִאֵיל שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ בִּשְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה רֹ֑חַב רָב֕וּעַ אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥עַת רְבָעָֽיו׃

passages.text: The ledge shall also be square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it. The steps of the altar shall face east.”
passages.sermon:
The altar has a ledge.
The ledge is square.
The ledge is fourteen cubits long.
The ledge is fourteen cubits wide.
The ledge has four corners.
A rim surrounds the ledge.
The rim is half a cubit high.
A gutter surrounds the ledge.
The gutter is one cubit wide.
Steps lead up to the altar.
The steps face east.
passages.original: וְהָעֲזָרָ֞ה אַרְבַּ֧ע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֹ֗רֶךְ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ רֹ֔חַב אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רְבָעֶ֑יהָ וְהַגְּבוּל סָבִ֨יב אוֹתָ֜הּ חֲצִ֣י הָאַמָּ֗ה וְהַֽחֵיק־ לָ֤הּ אַמָּה֙ סָבִ֔יב וּמַעֲלֹתֵ֖הוּ פְּנ֥וֹת קָדִֽים׃

passages.text: Then He said to me: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed, so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be sprinkled on it: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok, who approach Me to minister before Me, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He said, "These are the rules for the altar."
These rules apply on the day the altar is built.
The altar is for offering burnt sacrifices.
The altar is for sprinkling blood.
You must give a young bull from the herd.
This bull is a sin offering.
You must give the bull to the Levitical priests.
These priests come from the family of Zadok.
These priests come near to serve Me.
I am the Lord GOD.
I have declared this.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אֵ֚לֶּה חֻקּ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הֵעָֽשׂוֹת֑וֹ לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ עוֹלָ֔ה וְלִזְרֹ֥ק עָלָ֖יו דָּֽם׃ וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ מִזֶּ֨רַע צָד֜וֹק הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלַ֗י נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי פַּ֥ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and all around the rim; thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the altar.
God told the people to use a sin offering.
The priests must take some of the bull’s blood.
They must put the blood on the four horns of the altar.
They must also put the blood on the four corners of the ledge.
They must put the blood all around the rim of the altar.
This action will cleanse the altar.
This action will make atonement for the altar.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִדָּמ֗וֹ וְנָ֨תַתָּ֜ה עַל־ אַרְבַּ֤ע קַרְנֹתָיו֙ וְאֶל־ אַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֔ה וְאֶֽל־ הַגְּב֖וּל סָבִ֑יב וְחִטֵּאתָ֥ אוֹת֖וֹ וְכִפַּרְתָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Then you are to take away the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God gave Ezekiel instructions for the altar.
God said to take the bull.
The bull is for the sin offering.
You must remove the bull.
You must burn the bull.
Burn the bull in the appointed place.
The appointed place is in the temple area.
The appointed place is outside the sanctuary.
passages.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וּשְׂרָפוֹ֙ בְּמִפְקַ֣ד הַבַּ֔יִת מִח֖וּץ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and the altar is to be cleansed as it was with the bull.
passages.sermon:
On the second day, you must present a male goat.
The goat must be unblemished.
You must offer the goat as a sin offering.
You must cleanse the altar with the goat’s blood.
Cleanse the altar in the same way you cleansed it with the bull.
passages.original: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּקְרִ֛יב שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים תָּמִ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְחִטְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר חִטְּא֖וּ בַּפָּֽר׃

passages.text: When you have finished the purification, you are to present a young, unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for purifying the altar.
The priests must finish the purification process.
After this, they must present two animals.
They must bring a young, unblemished bull.
They must also bring an unblemished ram from the flock.
passages.original: בְּכַלּוֹתְךָ֖ מֵֽחַטֵּ֑א תַּקְרִיב֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֣ר תָּמִ֔ים וְאַ֥יִל מִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן תָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: You must present them before the LORD; the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
You must bring the animals before the LORD.
The priests take the animals.
The priests sprinkle salt on the animals.
The priests offer the animals as a burnt offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִשְׁלִ֨יכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֶ֔לַח וְהֶעֱל֥וּ אוֹתָ֛ם עֹלָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for purifying the altar.
For seven days, you must bring offerings each day.
Each day, you must provide a male goat for a sin offering.
You must also provide a young bull.
You must also provide a ram from the flock.
The bull and the ram must be unblemished.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׂעִיר־ חַטָּ֖את לַיּ֑וֹם וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר וְאַ֥יִל מִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן תְּמִימִ֥ים יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.
passages.sermon:
The priests will serve God.
The priests will work for seven days.
The priests will make atonement for the altar.
The priests will cleanse the altar.
The priests will consecrate the altar.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יְכַפְּרוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְטִֽהֲר֖וּ אֹת֑וֹ וּמִלְא֖וּ יָדוֹ׃

passages.text: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is the Lord.
God is the Lord GOD of Israel.
God gives instructions to the people.
The priests serve God.
The priests offer sacrifices to God.
Seven days will pass.
These days will come to an end.
On the eighth day, the priests will begin a new task.
From the eighth day onward, the priests will present your burnt offerings on the altar.
The priests will also present your peace offerings on the altar.
God will accept you.
The Lord GOD declares this.
